goal: Prevent nodes from wrongly penalizing and halting gossip of valid peers on other networks
Stops local network reachability drops from marking remote peers bad when one network remains active
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (fjahr, brunoerg)
Concept approval as matching the intended design for connection tracking (stratospher)
Verified by testing connection logging across networks against master (naiyoma)
Resolved concern that unreachable network addresses might persist indefinitely (stratospher)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents local connectivity outages on one network from corrupting peer gossip on others
Keeps reachable remote peers on networks like Tor or IPv6 from being marked bad due to local faults
